ranking_rules_daily_ranking_content: 1.4% of the total daily platform turnover is contributed to the daily Prize Pool, which will be distributed automatically and daily to the players according to their own position in the Daily Ranking.
ranking_rules_weekly_ranking_content: 0.6% of the total weekly turnover of the platform is contributed to the weekly Prize Pool, which will be distributed automatically and weekly to the players according to their own position in the Weekly Ranking.
ranking_rules_monthly_ranking_content: 0.1% of the platform's total daily turnover is donated to the monthly reward Prize pool, which is automatically distributed to players every month. According to the player's rank in the Monthly Ranking.
ranking_rules_activity_rules_1: Players' ranking in the Daily, Weekly and Monthly Rankings are based on the player's corresponding total betting turnover.
ranking_rules_activity_rules_2: Rewards will be displayed on the Ranking Event page.
ranking_rules_activity_rules_3: Calculation of the Daily Ranking starts at 00:00 local time and end ens on Daily rewards will be paid out within half an hour after the end of the Daily Rankings.
ranking_rules_activity_rules_4: Weekly Ranking calculation starts at 00:00 local time on Monday and ends at 24:00 local time on Sunday. Weekly Rewards will be issued within half an hour after the end of the weekly cycle.
ranking_rules_activity_rules_5: Monthly Rankings are calculated from 00:00 local time on the first day of the month until 24:00 local time on the last day of the month. Monthly Rewards will be issued within half an hour after the end of the monthly cycle.
ranking_rules_activity_rules_6: All players must bind their mobile phone number to participate in receiving rewards.
ranking_rules_terms_and_conditions_1: Players must provide mobile phone number and bank account details before applying for the rewards. Phone numbers, IP addresses and bank account details must match their region and profile, and any abnormal activities of the players would lead to void their winnings or profits.
ranking_rules_terms_and_conditions_2: Players who open multiple or fraudulent accounts will be disqualified from promotion events due to their illegitimate behaviours on the platform, and those accounts will be frozen.
